review.subtitle: Hamilton Khaki Field Mechanical 38 mm, blue dial, blue NATO strap
notes: Front photo is the straight-on image you supplied (1869 x 2909 px).

Case, sloped bezel, lugs and crown are modelled in matte bead-blasted steel as in the photo; the white hands with their cream lume, the round seconds counterweight and the lume arrow are modelled too. The dial print and the NATO strap come from the photo.
Heights are estimated from the official 9.5 mm (no side photo); the NATO buckle beside the top strap is not modelled.
